oneOf.title: granite-3.3-8b-instruct
oneOf.description:
An 8b-parameter instruction-tuned LLM used for natural language understanding and generation tasks. In this project, it powers tasks such as prompt-based reasoning, summarization, answer generation, and other LLM-driven functionalities.

**Model strengths**: Reliable instruction-following, natural conversation, strong reasoning, and enterprise-grade accuracy.

**Supported Languages**: English (primary), Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and 100+ more.

oneOf.title: gemma-4-26B-A4B-it
oneOf.description:
A 26B-parameter multimodal instruction-tuned model from Google. Runs on a single Spyre card (tp=1) using the Spyre 2.0 inference image.

**Model strengths**: Strong reasoning, multimodal understanding, and instruction-following.

**Supported Languages**: English (primary) and 140+ languages.

oneOf.title: Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512-BF16
oneOf.description:
A 14B-parameter instruction-tuned model from Mistral AI in BF16 precision. Requires 4 Spyre cards (tp=4) using the Spyre 3.6 inference image.

**Model strengths**: Fast inference, strong instruction-following, text-only tasks.

**Supported Languages**: English (primary), French, German, Spanish, Italian, and more.
